{{Quote|Czerka trained the rest of the galaxy.|Common motto in the exploration community|<ref name="TUR">''[[The Unknown Regions]]''</ref>}}
'''Survey and Development''' was a division of the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Mining Corporation]] which was one of the most prolific scouting divisions within corporate bodies of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="TUR" />

As it was one of the best known corporate scout division, it was responsible for charting new worlds with the company later being responsible for selling colonization rights to [[Planet/Legends|planets]] discovered that the corporation did not want. Many first generation scouts actually were trained from the Czerka program and brought their experiences with them. As such, they pioneered the many standard protocols that were adopted by other scouting organizations over the years with Survey and Development demonstrating how scouts handled business.<ref name="TUR" />
